definition: The way that someone or something looks.
example: She has a very youthful appearance.

definition: The various aspects of a person's character that combine to make them different.
example: He has an outgoing and friendly personality.

definition: Hair that has no curves, waves, or curls.
example: She has long straight dark hair.

definition: Hair that grows in curls or spirals.
example: He has short curly brown hair.

definition: Hair having gentle curves.
example: She has blonde wavy hair.

definition: Hair that grows on the chin and cheeks of a man's face.
example: He grew a thick beard over the winter.

definition: Hair that grows on a man's upper lip.
example: He has a neatly trimmed moustache.

definition: Too heavy or fat; above a normal or desirable weight.
example: A bit overweight.

definition: Attractively thin.
example: She is tall and slim.

definition: Having little or no hair on the head.
example: My grandfather is completely bald.

definition: Behaving in a kind and pleasant way.
example: The hotel staff were polite and friendly.

definition: Not kind or pleasant; hostile.
example: The clerk was cold and unfriendly.

definition: Liking to talk a lot.
example: She is very talkative and easy to talk with.

definition: Making little noise; speaking little.
example: He is quiet and thoughtful.

definition: Giving or willing to give freely; not mean.
example: It was very generous of you to pay for dinner.

definition: Not willing to give or share things, especially money.
example: He's too mean to buy a round of drinks.

definition: Making you laugh; amusing.
example: He told a very funny joke yesterday.

definition: Thinking about things in a careful way and not laughing much.
example: You need to be serious when taking an exam.

definition: Unwilling to work or use energy.
example: Get out of bed, you lazy boy!

definition: Putting a lot of effort into a job and doing it well.
example: She is a hard-working student who always does her homework.

definition: Nervous or embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people.
example: He was too shy to speak to the girl.

definition: A lively and confident person who enjoys being with other people.
example: As an extrovert, she loves meeting new people at parties.

definition: Quick at learning and understanding things.
example: She's very clever at mathematics.

definition: Caring about others; friendly and generous.
example: Thank you for your kind help.

definition: A knitted jacket that fastens up the front with buttons.
example: She put on a warm woollen cardigan.

definition: An outer garment with sleeves, worn outdoors.
example: Don't forget your winter coat!

definition: A set of clothes made of the same fabric, typically a jacket and trousers or a skirt.
example: He wore a navy blue suit to the interview.

definition: A loose, warm set of clothes with trousers and a top, worn for exercise.
example: He goes jogging in a grey tracksuit.

definition: Soft athletic shoes suitable for sports (US: sneakers).
example: I need a new pair of running trainers.

definition: Light sandals, typically made of plastic or rubber, with a thong between the big toe and the second toe.
example: She wore flip-flops to the beach.

definition: A journey in an aircraft.
example: Our flight to London was delayed by two hours.

definition: Bags, cases, etc. that you take with you when travelling.
example: You can leave your luggage at the hotel reception.

definition: A card that a passenger must have to be allowed on a plane or ship.
example: Please show your passport and boarding pass at gate 4.

definition: An official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country.
example: Don't forget to pack your passport before leaving!

definition: A thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event.
example: We bought some fridge magnets as souvenirs.

definition: Sit or lie in the sun, especially to get a tan.
example: We spent the afternoon sunbathing on the beach.

definition: Pay money to borrow something for a short time.
example: We decided to hire bicycles for the weekend.

definition: A period of time by which something is late or postponed.
example: There is a 30-minute delay on the train service.

definition: An exit from an airport building to an aircraft.
example: Flight BA142 is now boarding at Gate 12.

definition: A building at an airport where passengers arrive and depart.
example: All international flights depart from Terminal 2.
